t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two groups of gnomes. Gnomes in the same group provide similar numbers of mushrooms and this relationship remains consistent. However, as the game progresses the number of mushrooms can change from high to low. The time it takes for this change to occur shortens through higher rounds.

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 groups of gnomes and the gnomes within the same group provide similar numbers of mushrooms. There are some gnomes with earthy colours (Green, Yellow, Orange, Brown) and gnomes with less nature related colours (purple, pink, red, blue). As the game progresses there seems to be a change in the number of mushrooms produced by this group. There is a multiplier presented before the gnomes of either x1 or x5. I would recommend testing whether the gnome high/low relationship has chnaged on a x1 multiplier to minimise the number of mushrooms you miss out on.
